name: maykraft-platform
description: MayKraft Studios — MERN platform for managers, editors and clients

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
